stories.title: Le prix Nobel de la paix est décerné à la Sud-Africaine Navanethem "Navi" Pillay, "pour ses efforts en faveur de la promotion de la paix et du droit international"

en.title: The Nobel Peace Prize is awarded to South African Navanethem "Navi" Pillay, "for her efforts in promoting peace and international law"
en.summary: The 85-year-old Navanethem Pillay received the Nobel Peace Prize for her work on peace and international law. She chaired a UN independent inquiry that accused Israel of genocide in Gaza.

stories.title: Le Nobel de la paix à la Navi Pillay, une vie de combat contre les atrocités

en.title: Nobel Peace Prize awarded to Navi Pillay, a lifetime fighting atrocities
en.summary: South African lawyer Navi Pillay, 80, won the Nobel Peace Prize for her advocacy of international law and human rights. She has worked extensively in international justice institutions.

stories.title: Prix Nobel de la paix : Navanethem Pillay, l’inlassable avocate de la justice internationale

en.title: Nobel Peace Prize: Navanethem Pillay, tireless advocate for international justice
en.summary: South African judge Navanethem Pillay, 85, received the Nobel Peace Prize recognizing her extensive work in international criminal tribunals and human rights investigations. She recently led a UN commission examining alleged genocide in Gaza.

stories.title: Primaire à gauche : le vote est prolongé jusqu’à dimanche 18 heures, en raison de la cyberattaque qui a visé la plateforme

en.title: Left-wing primary: voting extended until Sunday 6 PM due to cyberattack on platform
en.summary: A cyberattack disrupted the online voting platform for a left-wing primary election, prompting organizers to extend voting until Sunday evening. Organizers stated vote integrity remained protected despite the disruption.

stories.title: Primaire de la gauche : le vote prolongé jusqu’à dimanche 18 heures après une cyberattaque

en.title: Left-wing primary: voting extended until Sunday 6 PM following cyberattack
en.summary: A cyberattack involving fake connections overwhelmed the online voting platform for a left-wing primary election. Voting was extended to Sunday evening to accommodate disruptions.

stories.title: Primaire sociale-démocrate : la plateforme de vote victime d’une cyberattaque, le vote prolongé jusqu’à dimanche 18 heures

en.title: Social Democratic primary: voting platform hit by cyberattack, voting extended until Sunday 6pm
en.summary: The e-votez voting platform for a social democratic primary experienced disruptions from a massive influx of fake connections starting Friday morning. The vote was extended by 24 hours to accommodate over 140,000 participants affected by the technical issues.

stories.title: Nobel de la paix à Navi Pillay : «Un signal fort dans un monde marqué par les reculs en matière de droits humains»

en.title: Peace Nobel to Navi Pillay: "A strong signal in a world marked by setbacks in human rights"
en.summary: South African legal expert Navi Pillay received the Nobel Peace Prize. A close collaborator reflects on the recognition of this international justice figure amid global challenges to human rights and the rule of law.

stories.title: Navi Pillay, un Nobel de la paix dans le chaos des guerres et les violations du droit

en.title: Navi Pillay, a Peace Nobel in the chaos of wars and violations of law
en.summary: The Oslo committee honored 85-year-old South African jurist Navi Pillay for her work advancing international justice against dictators and authoritarian leaders. Her recognition comes as some nations, including the United States, have sanctioned the International Criminal Court.

stories.title: Mobilisation des lycéens, premier tour de la primaire sociale-démocrate, le Nobel de la paix à la Sud-Africaine Navi Pillay… L’actu de ce vendredi 9 octobre

en.title: Mobilization of high school students, first round of social democratic primary, Peace Nobel to South African Navi Pillay… Friday October 9 news roundup
en.summary: Libération's newsroom summarizes the main events of Friday, covering student mobilization, a social democratic primary round, and the Peace Nobel award announcement.

stories.title: Prix Nobel de la paix 2026 - Qui est Navanethem “Navi” Pillay ?

en.title: 2026 Nobel Peace Prize - Who is Navanethem "Navi" Pillay?
en.summary: Navanethem "Navi" Pillay received the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize on Friday, October 9. She is the fourth African woman selected by the Nobel Committee.

stories.title: Navi Pillay prix Nobel de la paix 2026 : paix et droit international à l'honneur

en.title: Navi Pillay awarded Nobel Peace Prize 2026: peace and international law honored
en.summary: Navi Pillay has been awarded the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize, recognizing contributions to peace and international law.

stories.title: South African former UN human rights chief Navi Pillay wins Nobel Peace Prize

en.title: South African former UN human rights chief Navi Pillay wins Nobel Peace Prize
en.summary: Navanethem Pillay, a South African judge who led the Rwanda genocide tribunal and headed a UN commission accusing Israel of genocide in Gaza, received the Nobel Peace Prize.

stories.title: OPINION. « Déléguer sa plume à l’IA : la fin du "ni vu ni connu" »

en.title: OPINION. "Delegating one's writing to AI: the end of flying under the radar"
en.summary: A scandal involving author Thélyson Orélien's novel raises questions about AI progress, the creative process, the future of reading amid artificial content, and the competence of literary and media elites.

stories.title: Amazon fait sa révolution robotique dans l’Oise

en.title: Amazon carries out its robotic revolution in Oise
en.summary: Amazon inaugurated a new distribution center in Beauvais on Friday, targeting 1,000 jobs. The facility features advanced robotic technologies, including AI systems.

stories.title: Retraites, donation, PTZ « parentalité » : ce qu'ont voté les députés en commission pour le budget 2027

en.title: Pensions, donations, PTZ "parenthood": what lawmakers voted for in committee for the 2027 budget
en.summary: French parliament's finance commission began examining the 2027 financial bill on Wednesday, October 7, with votes on provisions regarding pensions, donations, and housing-related measures.

stories.title: OPINION. « Ni le RN, ni la technocratie : redonnons le pouvoir aux habitants des villes Sous-préfectures et aux territoires ruraux », par Fabien Verdier

en.title: OPINION. "Neither the RN nor technocracy: let's give power back to residents of sub-prefecture cities and rural territories," by Fabien Verdier
en.summary: Fabien Verdier argues for redistributing political power to local territories and rural areas as a response to the rise of the National Rally and excessive political centralization.

stories.title: Tout en montant en cadence, Embraer livre son premier E195-E2 à Latam Airlines

en.title: Embraer delivers first E195-E2 to Latam Airlines while ramping up production
en.summary: Latam Airlines received its first E195-E2 aircraft from Embraer on October 8, with 11 additional aircraft expected as Embraer increases production capacity.
